text: Nahmias et al. (2013) showed that a semiconductor laser with a saturable-absorber section, biased just below threshold, maps rigorously onto which neuron model?
choices: The Hodgkin-Huxley conductance model with four coupled variables
explanation: The chapter states Nahmias et al. (2013) proved the two-section saturable-absorber laser maps rigorously onto the LIF equations, with the optical field as the fast variable and carrier density as the slow recovery variable. Hodgkin-Huxley is a more detailed model not the one claimed; McCulloch-Pitts and the perceptron are non-spiking, non-dynamical units that cannot capture excitable spiking.
